title: Rav Yehuda of Difta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned once in [Berakhot 25a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.25a.21): Ravina says, “I was standing before Rav Yehudah of Difta. He saw excrement and told me, ‘Check whether its surface has formed a crust.’” Hyman prefers the Dikdukei Soferim reading, Rav Yirmeyah of Difta, and gives this as the reason Yuchasin did not include him.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman prefers the Yirmeyah of Difta reading to Yehuda of Difta and offers this as the explanation for the omission from Yuchasin (היוחסין). This is his textual judgment and survey claim; the heading is preserved.

The linked Bavli gives the name Yehuda of Difti and has Ravina receive the instruction. Its alternate wording asks whether the surface has cracked. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1711&lang=en) renders the two roles in the opposite direction in its Hebrew.
